title: feat: implement V2-BE-062/061/060/059 - SIWE nonces, rate limits, cache registry, claim search
head: zainabbaba31-source:feature/zainab-wallet-cache-search
body:
Implements the following issues:

- **Closes #413** (V2-BE-062): Implement One-Time Wallet Authentication Nonces
  - Enhanced SiweNonceService with action-bound nonces (sign_in, wallet_link, wallet_unlink, transaction_sign, admin_action)
  - Cryptographically secure nonce generation (256-bit entropy)
  - Nonce hashing for storage security (SHA-256)
  - Per-wallet nonce limits with automatic cleanup
  - Expiration tracking and automatic cleanup job
  - SIWE message building per EIP-4361 with resources support
  - Verification with signature validation

- **Closes #412** (V2-BE-061): Add Wallet-Scoped and Endpoint-Cost Rate Limits
  - Created WalletRateLimiterService with wallet/user/IP-based identity extraction
  - Endpoint cost multipliers (auth=10x, claims=5x, disputes=5x, admin=20x, health=0.1x)
  - Wallet tier system (new/basic/trusted/premium/admin) with configurable multipliers
  - Lua-scripted atomic Redis counters for accuracy
  - IP reputation checking and API key trust levels
  - Automatic blocking with configurable duration
  - Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-*) for clients

- **Closes #411** (V2-BE-060): Create a Canonical API Cache-Key Registry
  - Created CacheKeyRegistryService with centralized key definitions
  - Versioned keys with scopes (global/tenant/wallet/user/chain/contract)
  - Tag-based, pattern-based, and scope-based invalidation
  - Projection watermark support for consistency
  - Pre-registered keys for claims, disputes, identity, rewards, leaderboard, config, analytics, search, blockchain
  - TTL by scope, tags for grouped invalidation
  - Cache statistics and registry export for documentation

- **Closes #410** (V2-BE-059): Build Projection-Only Claim Search
  - Created ProjectionClaimSearchService with bounded search from read models
  - Full-text search on title, description, tags
  - Filters: states, status, chainIds, contracts, submitter, verifier, date ranges, rewards
  - Stable cursor-based pagination with projection watermark consistency
  - Sorting by createdAt, updatedAt, rewardAmount, reputationScore
  - Specialized methods: by submitter, by verifier, by state, moderation queue
  - Projection snapshot for consistency verification
  - Caching integration via CacheKeyRegistry
